prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Because every node now reports its own calibration drift, the redesign ____ the need for a quarterly visit to each remote site.
explanation: obviate 的意思是「事先讓某件事變得不再必要」，最典型的搭配就是 obviate the need for + 名詞：需求本身被消滅，而不是需求被壓下或延後。句中「每個節點自己回報偏移」正是讓現場巡檢失去存在理由的條件，語氣也符合 obviate 的正式書面色彩。

distractorExplanations.b: forestall 是「搶先一步阻止某個即將發生的事件」，受詞通常是 a crisis、criticism 這類事件；the need 是一種狀態而非事件，forestall the need 並非慣用搭配。
distractorExplanations.c: prohibit 是以規定或權威明令禁止，受詞得是行為或人，而且需要一個下令者；技術改版並不能「禁止」一項需求。
distractorExplanations.d: relinquish 是放棄自己原本握有的東西（權利、控制權、職位），需求並不是握在手上的資產，語意不合。

options.text: Management remained oblivious about the growing backlog until customers began cancelling.
Management remained oblivious to the growing backlog until customers began cancelling.
The backlog stayed oblivious for several weeks before anyone escalated it.
The clerk was oblivious to hand over the signed copy before the office closed.

explanation: oblivious 描述「人完全沒有察覺到周遭的某件事」，固定接介系詞 to（較正式的書面也可用 of），後面放的是那件沒被察覺的事。be oblivious to the backlog 正是「積壓已經在長大，管理層卻毫無所覺」。

distractorExplanations.a: 介系詞錯了：oblivious 不搭 about。about 用於 concerned about、reticent about 這類「針對某話題」的形容詞，oblivious 講的是「意識不到」，要用 to 或 of。
distractorExplanations.c: 主語錯了：oblivious 形容的是「沒察覺的人」，不是「沒被察覺的事」。要說事情沒被注意到，應該用 went unnoticed。
distractorExplanations.d: oblivious 後面不接不定詞。忘了做某件該做的事要用 forgot to hand over 或 neglected to hand over；oblivious 只講認知狀態，不講疏忽的動作。

prompt: Choose the phrase that best completes the sentence.
context: The steering committee insisted ____ that every assumption in the model be documented, so that nothing would have to be reconstructed at the review.
explanation: outset 只活在兩個固定片語裡：at the outset（在起點那一刻）與 from the outset（從一開始就一直如此）。句中「堅持要求」是一項貫穿整個專案的立場，涵蓋一段期間，因此要用帶有起點加延續意味的 from the outset。

distractorExplanations.a: 英文沒有 in the outset 這個說法；表示「在開頭階段」要說 at the outset。
distractorExplanations.b: on the outset 同樣不存在。on 用於 on arrival、on completion 這類動作名詞，outset 不在其列。
distractorExplanations.d: by + 時間點意思是「在那之前完成」，by the outset 等於「在開始之前就結束」，邏輯不通。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: A habit of quiet cost-cutting had begun to ____ every level of the organisation, from procurement decisions down to how meeting rooms were booked.
explanation: permeate 可以直接接受詞（permeate the organisation），描述氣味、風氣或觀念「無孔不入地擴散到整體的每個角落」，語氣正式，正好搭配句中從採購到訂會議室的層層滲透。

distractorExplanations.a: diffuse 作動詞時多為不及物（heat diffuses through the material）；及物用法限於 diffuse light、diffuse tension，不能說 diffuse every level。
distractorExplanations.b: immerse 的句型是 immerse somebody / oneself in something，受詞是被浸入的人或物，介系詞不可省略。
distractorExplanations.c: encroach 是不及物動詞，必須接 on 或 upon，而且帶有「侵占別人地盤」的意味，與風氣自然擴散不同。

options.text: Unlicensed resale sites proliferated in the months after the ticketing rules were relaxed.
The agency proliferated the new guidance to every regional office.
The committee proliferated over the wording for another hour before voting.
The proliferate of counterfeit parts alarmed the safety board.

explanation: proliferate 是不及物動詞，主語就是那個「快速變多」的東西本身：sites proliferated 表示轉售網站的數量在短時間內暴增，常帶有「多到失控」的負面意味，正合鬆綁法規之後的情境。

distractorExplanations.b: proliferate 不能當「散發、下發」用，也不接受詞加 to。要說把指引發到各分處，動詞是 distribute 或 circulate。
distractorExplanations.c: 這裡要表達的是「反覆討論」，該用 deliberated over the wording；proliferate 與 deliberate 只是形近，意思毫無關聯。
distractorExplanations.d: 詞性錯了：proliferate 是動詞，名詞形式為 proliferation，應說 the proliferation of counterfeit parts。

options.text: Cracking is prone in this alloy whenever the part is cooled too quickly.
This alloy is prone to cracking whenever the part is cooled too quickly.
Our senior technician is prone to double-check the seal before signing off.
This alloy is prone of sudden cracking under rapid cooling conditions.

explanation: prone 的句型是 be prone to + 名詞或動名詞，主語是「容易出這種毛病的人或物」，後面接的是那個不樂見的結果。be prone to cracking 說的正是合金本身有開裂傾向，而不是開裂這件事有傾向。

distractorExplanations.a: 主語擺錯了：prone 的主語必須是有此傾向的主體（合金），不能是那個傾向本身。要以 cracking 開頭，得說 Cracking is common in this alloy。
distractorExplanations.c: prone 帶負面意味，後面接的必須是不樂見的傾向；「多檢查一次密封」是值得肯定的習慣，應改用 makes a point of double-checking。
distractorExplanations.d: 介系詞錯了：prone 固定搭 to，沒有 prone of 的用法。

options.text: From an investor's prospective, the merger looks purely defensive.
The report is highly prospective about the industry's chances of recovery.
The firm keeps a file on every prospective client its partners have pitched to.
Sales in the prospective quarter are expected to recover only slowly.

explanation: prospective 是放在名詞前的形容詞，指「尚未確定但可能成為某種身分的人」：prospective client 就是還沒簽約、但有機會成交的潛在客戶，語氣正式，常見於商務文件。

distractorExplanations.a: 拼字混淆了：表示「觀點、角度」的名詞是 perspective，應寫 from an investor's perspective；prospective 沒有名詞用法。
distractorExplanations.b: prospective 不作述語形容詞，也不表示「看好」。要說報告對前景樂觀，該用 optimistic about。
distractorExplanations.d: prospective 不修飾時間單位。「下一季」要說 the coming quarter 或 the next quarter。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The two delegations initialled a ____ agreement in Geneva, but it will carry no legal force until each parliament has ratified the text.
explanation: provisional 指「已經談定、但尚未正式定案，還等著上級程序確認」的狀態，正對應句中「要等國會批准才生效」。provisional agreement、provisional government 都是這個意思，重點在效力未定，而不在時間長短。

distractorExplanations.a: transient 形容轉瞬即逝的現象（transient faults、transient population），不用來描述協議的法律地位。
distractorExplanations.b: makeshift 指臨時湊合、品質將就的替代品，多用於實體安排；用它會變成批評這份協議草率，而非說明它尚待批准。
distractorExplanations.c: temporary 說的是「有效期很短」，前提是它已經生效；句中的協議根本還沒生效，兩者的重點不同。

options.text: It would be prudent to hedge at least part of the exposure before the vote.
The treasurer prudented the reserves through two successive recessions.
She is a prudent of currency risk and rarely leaves a position unhedged.
The fund's prudent timidity cost it every chance of joining the recovery.

explanation: prudent 是形容詞，最常用的句型就是 it is prudent to + 原形動詞，用來評價一個基於長遠考量而做出的明智選擇。句中在表決前先避險，正是典型的審慎作為。

distractorExplanations.b: prudent 沒有動詞形式。要表達「穩健地守住準備金」，可說 managed the reserves prudently。
distractorExplanations.c: prudent 不是名詞；抽象名詞是 prudence，而且形容人謹慎面對某風險應說 is prudent about currency risk。
distractorExplanations.d: prudent 是褒義評價，與 timidity（過度膽怯）以及後半句的批評自相矛盾；要責備過度保守，應該用 excessive caution。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The panel accepted the study's ____ findings, which rested on 4,000 survey responses, but noted that its thirty interviews had been analysed far less systematically.
explanation: quantitative 指「以數字衡量、可統計」的那一類資料與分析，四千份問卷正屬此類；句子刻意把它和後半段訪談的處理拿來對比，就是學術寫作裡 quantitative 與 qualitative 的標準分工。

distractorExplanations.a: qualitative 指訪談、觀察這類非數值材料，正是句中後半被批評的部分，填在前半會前後矛盾。
distractorExplanations.c: quantifiable 意思是「有辦法被量化的」，描述尚未量化但可量化的對象（quantifiable benefits）；問卷結果已經量化完成，不再用這個字。
distractorExplanations.d: numeral 指的是數字符號本身（如 Roman numerals），不能用來形容研究方法或資料類型。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The chief executive's two-paragraph memo did little to ____ speculation that a second round of layoffs was already being planned.
explanation: quell 是及物動詞，受詞常是 fear、rumour、speculation、unrest 這類正在擴散的騷動，意思是「以行動把它壓下去」。語氣正式，用在公司內部謠言與市場臆測上是標準搭配。

distractorExplanations.a: abate 在現代英文中幾乎只作不及物（the storm abated），指自行減弱；說 abate speculation 不合語法。
distractorExplanations.b: quench 的受詞限於 thirst 或 flames 等實體，抽象的臆測不能用它熄滅。
distractorExplanations.d: deter 的句型是 deter somebody from doing something，受詞必須是被嚇阻的人，不能直接接 speculation。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: In the redesign the search box, once the first thing a visitor saw, was ____ to a small grey link at the foot of the page.
explanation: relegate 專指「把人或事物移到比原本更不重要的位置」，句型是 be relegated to + 名詞。搜尋框從最顯眼處被挪到頁尾小連結，正是地位被下放，語氣也帶有惋惜或批評的意味。

distractorExplanations.a: delegate 是把任務或職權「交辦」給某人，受詞是工作、對象是人；版面元素不會被交辦。
distractorExplanations.b: demote 用於人的職位或正式等級（demoted to assistant manager），不用來描述介面元素在版面上的位置。
distractorExplanations.c: defer 是把事情延後處理，講的是時間，不是重要性的高低。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: Within hours the ministry ____ the leaked memo, insisting that it reflected no one's policy but its author's and had never been approved by anybody.
explanation: repudiate 是「正式宣告不承認某事物的效力或歸屬」，受詞常是 claim、agreement、document。部會強調備忘錄從未經任何人核可，正是在否認它代表官方立場，這種公開切割就是 repudiate 的核心語意。

distractorExplanations.b: rebuff 是無禮或斷然地回絕別人主動提出的邀約、示好或提議，受詞必須是那個提議或提議的人，不能是一份外流文件。
distractorExplanations.c: revoke 只能撤銷自己先前授予的東西（執照、許可、資格）；部會既然主張從未核可，就沒有東西可撤。
distractorExplanations.d: renounce 是放棄自己原本擁有的權利、頭銜或主張；用它反而等於承認這份備忘錄本來屬於部會，與句意相反。

options.text: The candidate rescinded from the offer two days before her start date.
The board rescinded the remote-work policy just three weeks after adopting it.
Orders rescinded sharply in the final quarter of the financial year.
The judge rescinded that the earlier ruling had rested on a clerical error.

explanation: rescind 是及物動詞，受詞是自己先前正式做成的決定、規定或錄取通知，意思是「以同樣正式的程序把它取消、視同未曾存在」。董事會撤回自己三週前通過的政策，正是標準用法。

distractorExplanations.a: rescind 不接 from，也不用於「自己退出」。求職者拒絕已接受的錄取要說 withdrew from the offer 或 turned down the offer。
distractorExplanations.c: rescind 不是不及物動詞，也沒有「下滑」的意思；訂單大幅下降應說 orders fell sharply 或 declined sharply。
distractorExplanations.d: rescind 後面不接 that 子句。法官表示先前判決有誤，動詞要用 conceded 或 acknowledged。

prompt: Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
context: The witness was noticeably ____ about her employer's accounting practices, answering in single sentences and volunteering nothing that counsel had not asked for.
explanation: reticent 專指「針對某個話題不肯多談、有所保留」，固定搭配 be reticent about + 名詞。它描述的是對特定主題的守口如瓶，語氣中性，不預設對方是害羞還是有意隱瞞，正符合證人只答不說的情狀。

distractorExplanations.a: reluctant 表示不情願去做某事，句型是 be reluctant to + 原形動詞，後面接的是動作而不是話題。
distractorExplanations.b: diffident 指的是缺乏自信、畏縮，講的是人格特質，與「刻意不談某個題目」無關。
distractorExplanations.d: taciturn 形容一個人天生話少，是長期的性格描述，不能限定在某個話題上，因此不搭 about + 名詞。
